header: Supported OpenSearch SQL commands and functions
content:
The following reference tables show which SQL commands are supported in OpenSearch Discover
for querying data in Amazon S3, Security Lake, or CloudWatch Logs, and which SQL commands are
supported in CloudWatch Logs Insights. The SQL syntax supported in CloudWatch Logs Insights
and that supported in OpenSearch Discover for querying CloudWatch Logs are the same, and
referenced as CloudWatch Logs in the following tables.
Note
OpenSearch also has SQL support for querying data that is ingested in OpenSearch and
stored in indexes. This SQL dialect is diﬀerent than the SQL used in direct query and is
referred to as OpenSearch SQL on indexes.
